text:
maya: Quick sync — proposing a tabletop exercise next Wed to lock the perf launch playbook. We need clear launch gates for latency, throughput, kernels, quant, and KV behavior. Who can join?

dave: +1. I can cover kernel compatibility matrix and fallback paths.

li: I’ll bring telemetry and realistic p95/p99 numbers from canary runs. Need to align on obs queries we’ll use.

ana: (typo correction) ana: I can do quant validation notes and quality delta thresholds. Also want a decision tree for rollback vs mitigations.

maya: Great. Agenda draft: 1) acceptance SLOs (latency p50/p95/p99, tail risk), 2) throughput targets and autoscale triggers, 3) kernel compatibility + known unsupported ops, 4) quantization acceptance test + eval prompt set, 5) KV cache sizing + cold-start behavior, 6) canary & rollback playbook.

sophie: Add a customer-driven ask section — e.g., enterprise customers asking for zero-error fallback to non-quant model. We should map which customers require that as an SLA.

li: For obs queries, propose these metrics: 
```
- request_count
- tokens_per_request.mean
- latency.{p50,p95,p99}
- kv_hit_rate
- model_variant_fallbacks.count
- quality_regressions.{eval_set_name}
```

li: Will post exact dashboards before the meeting.

maya: For launch gates, draft example: must have p95 <= 220ms for short requests (<128 tokens) on dedicated pool, KV hit rate >= 85% for warmed pools, and end-to-end customer error rate < 0.1%. Thoughts?

dave: p95 220ms seems tight for some kernels on A100 with long sequences. Suggest we add sequence-length buckets: <128, 128-512, >512 and per-bucket targets. Also note quantized kernels may add 2-3% quality delta; that should be captured in gate 4.

ana: Agree. For quant gate: quality delta <= 1.5% on eval set A (latency-sensitive prompts) and no systematic hallucination regressions. Otherwise require fallback path or per-customer opt-out.

maya: Can we encode fallback policy succinctly? Something like: if quality delta > threshold OR error rate > X then route to non-quant model variant; if latency > target AND throughput degraded then scale up dedicated pool or route to cheaper region.

ops-bot: deploy scheduled: perf-canary v2 -> staging at 2026-04-01T03:00Z. Will post canary logs. :robot_face:

li: Tabletop deliverables: pre-read (dashboards + canary logs), playbook doc with gates + owners, list of customer opt-ins/opt-outs. I can own pre-read.

maya: Owners: dave -> kernel/fallbacks, ana -> quant tests, li -> telemetry + dashboards, sophie -> customer mapping and SLAs. I'll synthesize playbook after the tabletop.

ana: Quick proposal for rollback triggers (draft):
```
1) If model_variant_fallbacks.count spikes > 10x baseline for 15m -> immediate rollback to previous stable model.
2) If p99 latency > 2x target for 10m AND request error rate > 0.5% -> trigger mitigation runbook.
3) If eval quality regression > threshold on prod prompts -> pause quant rollout and enable per-customer fallback.
```

dave: Also include kernel-level diagnostics to collect: op types, kernel version, memory pressure, and slowop traces. That makes RCA faster.

maya: Meeting time: Wed 09:30 PT. Invite sent. Pre-reads in #eng-runtime pinned by li. Please add any customer ask links or runbooks before Tue EOD.

sophie: I added list of enterprise customers with strict quant opt-out flags to the doc. Will sync with AE.

li: Uploaded sample dashboards + canary snippets to the doc.

maya: Perfect. Goal: get a signed-off playbook and a single-page launch checklist by end of quarter. :memo:

sophie: :thumbsup:

ops-bot: reminder: perf-canary v2 runs in 6h.
